layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with generous padding to prevent text collision. Using 'Control Room' grid logic for the POS bill creation interface.
layout_and_spacing.pos_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. 2 columns for Menu, 1 column for Cart.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Soft shadows, rounded corners (rounded-2xl). Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-[#E8E4D9]).
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-24 or w-64 depending on state, bg-white border-r border-[#E8E4D9]

components_strategy.buttons: Rounded-full or rounded-xl. Smooth transition, slight lift on hover.
components_strategy.cards: Menu item cards should be rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden, with an image on top or left, soft shadow on hover.
components_strategy.cart_panel: Sticky to the right side on large screens. Distinct surface color (e.g. #F5F2EA) to separate from the menu.
components_strategy.forms_inputs: Shadcn UI base. Rounded-xl borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C97A7E]
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn tables for Bill History. Clean, unboxed rows (border-b only).
components_strategy.navigation: Left sidebar or top header with clear icons. Minimalist.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for menu items, buttons darken and get subtle drop shadow.
motion_and_interactions.cart_add: Micro-interaction: slight scale pulse when adding to cart.

login_background.description: Warm, cozy earthy gradient background for the login page (no external image dependency).

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend tailwind.config.js to include these custom colors in the theme block so they can be easily used across Shadcn and custom components.
Add 'Manrope' and 'DM Sans' to Google Fonts import in index.html and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Implement the Cashier login screen using the 'login_background' as a full cover background, with a glassy card in the center for the login form.
The main POS layout should use a side navigation (Sidebar) with icons for 'POS', 'Menu Management', and 'Bill History'.
In the POS Bill Creation view, implement a 'Control Room' grid: Left 2/3 for Menu Categories (tabs) and Items (grid), Right 1/3 for the Current Bill (Cart).
Use the 'surface_muted' color (#F5F2EA) for the Bill/Cart section to visually distinguish it from the white menu section.
Menu items should be represented as cards. Use the provided coffee images as placeholders.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and key elements for testing.
Ensure the Bill History page uses a clean Shadcn Table component, unboxed rows with bottom borders only.
Keep borders subtle and rounded (rounded-2xl for major cards, rounded-xl for buttons).
Avoid harsh black colors; use the dark espresso (#2A2421) for primary text.
